DisableForPlayers.Name: Disable PF2e Combater for players

RaisePcShieldsWhenDefending.Name: Raise PC shields when Defending

EnrageBarbariansAtCombatStart.Name: Enrage barbarians at combat start
EnrageBarbariansAtCombatStart.Hint: At combat start, apply Rage for PCs with Quick-Tempered and a Rage action configured with a self-applied effect. Works without opening the Combater panel.

LearnObservedIntel.Name: Learn Intel from what the party sees
LearnObservedIntel.Hint: During combat, when an enemy uses a Strike, reaction or ability in plain view, record it in the party's Intel for that creature, as if they had learned it. Abilities posted only to the GM are not learned.
